fit.why: Koren with the knee-width exponent m (triode_models.py). Fitted freely, m = 0.91: the datasheet curves prefer Koren's shape. m = 0.35 was chosen against measurement (Stereophile, Triode Lab 2A3 EVO, 50 Hz / 1 W spectrum, H3 about -55.5 dB), because the datasheet curves cannot decide H3 (refits and bootstrap: H3 within 0.6 dB; a different formula moves it 3 - 5 dB). Plate RMS 0.65 -> 0.96 % (+0.31 points); typical operating point mu / rp / gm -2 / +4 / -5 %.
fit.limits: The 2A3 EVO uses KR 2A3 tubes, which may differ from the RCA 1933 curves. H3 in the full circuit (12AX7 -> 6SN7 -> 2A3) is still about 6.5 dB above the EVO: known limitation, to be reviewed after the core model and listening.
